source: lab (captured; background replaced by pure white, i.e. segmentation-style rendering of a lab clip)

camera.motion: static (background is uniform white; pendulum pivot stays at ~(637,229) +-4 px in all frames)
camera.perspective_cues: No ground plane, horizon or furniture visible (background removed). Only depth cue is the ball's apparent size (equiv. diameter ~29-31 px at far end of swing, ~40-42 px at near end).

objects.name: ball
objects.description: small ball hanging on a string; red/orange in frames 0-11, rendered as a pale pink (~RGB 246,236,230) flat mask from frame 12 to 48 (same object, appearance change is a segmentation artifact)
objects.reference_point: centroid of the filled ball mask (cx, cy)

objects.name: string
objects.description: thin dark grey string from a fixed pivot at image top (~x 637, y 229) down to the ball; pivot support itself not visible

pivot_to_ball_centre_px.note: varies strongly because the swing is mostly toward/away from the camera (foreshortening)

objects.name: watermark
objects.description: small grey text box bottom-right (~x 1030-1279, y 690-719), overlay, not a physical object

events.event: ball already swinging at frame 0 (moving away/up in image)
far turning point 1 (ball highest in image, smallest)
lowest image position / passing nearest bottom of swing
near turning point 1 (ball largest, image-y local minimum ~378)
